utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Do you know what’s still needed for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard the latest yet, but I can swing by and check what’s still on the list.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks—can you tell me what’s still missing when you check?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Noah — I can lend a hand with tools for the repair drive. Just let me know what you need.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Gus — I’ll let you know what I need once I sort it out.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No problem, Noah — I’m around when you’re ready. Just give me a shout and I’ll see what I can lend.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, hi Pia — I heard the repair drive is getting organized, and folks are already pitching in. I’ll keep an ear out and let you know if I hear any more details.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Tess — that’d help a lot. I’m just trying to figure out the timing and what we need to bring.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing — I’ll ask around and see if anyone’s nailed down the timing or a list of supplies. If I hear anything, I’ll pass it right along.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Sam — could you check the back shed and the porch boxes for any repair supplies, then bring them to the community hall? That would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll check the back shed and the porch boxes, then bring anything useful to the community hall.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’ll spread the word about the repair drive right away—want me to invite a few more neighbors too?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yes, please. Thank you, Quinn—I’d really appreciate that.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll ask a few more neighbors today and let you know who can help.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Leo — I’m gathering the repair drive details now. I’ll keep it organized and make sure everyone knows what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Rosa. Let me know what tools or parts you need from me.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Leo — I’ll send you a neat list of tools and parts shortly. If you already have any basics on hand, that’d help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m here—what details do we need to confirm for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m a bit late, sorry—what’s still left to confirm for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: No worries—let’s just confirm the time, location, and what tools or parts we still need.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help work around the school schedule for the repair drive. What timing are you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’s so helpful, Faye—thank you. I’m thinking late afternoon after pickup, maybe around 4:30, so families can swing by.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 4:30 sounds workable for me; I can help spread the word to other parents. If you want, I can also help line up a few volunteers for that time.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard the repair drive’s getting some decent momentum—what do you know so far?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yeah, it’s been picking up nicely—folks seem pretty eager to pitch in. I’m still gathering the details, but it sounds like a good turnout so far.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’s great to hear—if you learn the time or where they’re setting up, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what’s the repair drive asking for?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I just want to make sure I’ve got it right—what exactly are they asking for?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Right — they’re asking for tools, spare parts, and a few hands to help with the fixes.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help out—what still needs fixing for the drive?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, thank you, Rey—my notes are a bit of a mess, but I know the cracked step by the porch and that loose fence board still need attention. If you can take one of those, that’d help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’ll take the cracked step by the porch and check it over today.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and make sure folks know the plan.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Vik — I’ll keep an eye on our supplies and set aside anything we can spare for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, I’ll remind neighbors and keep everyone posted on the drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Ira — I appreciate that.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: No problem — I’ll let you know if I hear anything about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive — I meant to ask if there’s a list of what still needs doing. I can help out, if that’s useful.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, there’s still a short list, and any help would be great. I can pass it along and repeat the plan to everyone.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: That’d be perfect, thanks. If you send me the list, I’ll do my best to follow it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? Right, I was meaning to ask about that—did anything change?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yes — we’re still on, but I’m checking a couple details before I confirm the time.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — just let me know once the time’s set.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand and bring over any tools we need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Gus. Let’s keep it simple: you bring the tools, and I’ll make a neat little list of what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — I’ll bring the basics over and we can fill in the gaps from your list.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Amazing, Mara — can you help spread the word to a few neighbors and sign up for a shift if you’re free?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I can spread the word to a few neighbors, and I’ll check my schedule for a shift too.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help spread the word about the repair drive—who should I reach out to first?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Jules — please start with the folks on Maple Street and the community bulletin board at the corner store.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll start with Maple Street and post the notice at the corner store bulletin board.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll keep the repair drive organized and make sure folks know where to bring their requests.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rosa — I’ll check our supplies and bring over anything we can spare.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Cleo — that’ll help a lot. I’ll keep a clean list of requests and let you know what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard the repair drive is happening soon, but I’m still piecing together the details. If you know what they need, I’m happy to pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Do they want tools, spare parts, or just volunteers? I can help spread the word once I know what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m not sure yet — I just heard it’s a bit of all three. If you find out the exact list, I can help pass it around.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—what do you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Could you help spread the word to the other parents and maybe bring a few supplies if you can? I’ll send you the details after I check the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can do that. Just send the details when you have them.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I can help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do first?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, you’re actually helping with the repair drive, right? If so, what should I bring or do first?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, I’m in — I’ll help with the repair drive. Could you bring a notepad and any tools you already have, and I’ll start by checking what needs fixing first?
